questions.question: What was Gollum's name before the Ring changed him?
questions.note: Frodo uses the old name to reach him.

questions.question: What does Gollum call the Ring?
questions.note: He says it to the Ring and about it.

questions.question: What burns Gollum when the hobbits tie him up?
questions.note: Sam's rope from Lothlórien. 'It burns us! It freezes!'

questions.question: Through which swamp of drowned faces does Gollum lead the hobbits?
questions.note: Faces of the fallen lie under the water. Frodo nearly falls in.

questions.question: What main entrance to Mordor does Gollum say is too well guarded?
questions.note: He offers another way in, by the secret stairs.

questions.question: What does Sam want to add to the rabbit stew?
questions.note: 'Po-tay-toes. Boil 'em, mash 'em, stick 'em in a stew.'

questions.question: How does Gollum like his fish?
Who does Gollum argue with by the pool at night?
questions.note: Gollum and Sméagol. Sméagol wins, for now: 'Leave now, and never come back.'

questions.question: What does Sméagol call Frodo?
questions.note: He calls Sam the fat hobbit.

questions.question: What giant war beasts do Frodo and Sam see in Ithilien?
questions.note: Sam is thrilled. The Gaffer will never believe it.
